question: Gurindervir Singh broke the national record in which athletic game in the Indian Grand Prix 1?
solution:
The correct answer is __**100 m**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Gurindervir Singh**, a talented sprinter from **Punjab**, dominated the tracks during the **Indian Grand Prix 1** (IGP 1).
 
• He competed in the **100 m** athletic game and clocked an impressive timing of **10.32 seconds**.
 
• The event was held at the **Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports (NSNIS)** in **Patiala** in **February 2021**.
 
• His performance in the **100 m** sprint was significant as it established him as the fastest man of the meet, showcasing his explosive acceleration and sprinting prowess.
 
• The **100 m** race is a premier track and field event
